title: Alertmanager
description: Alertmanager (alertmanager-kps-0): what is firing, whether alerts are received and whether notifications reach their receivers. Curated from the official alertmanager-mixin (https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/tree/main/doc/alertmanager-mixin) dashboard and alerts; the chart's 'Alertmanager / Overview' (folder Kubernetes) stays as reference.

list.name: Firing alerts
list.textFormat: Prometheus ALERTS series in state firing. See Alertmanager / alert rules for details.

list.name: Container restarts
list.textFormat: kube-state-metrics saw the restart counter change (crash, OOMKill or liveness failure).

list.name: Config reloads
list.textFormat: New routes/receivers loaded by the config-reloader sidecar.

options.content:
**Alertmanager** receives alerts from Prometheus, groups/deduplicates/silences them and sends notifications
to *receivers* (Slack, e-mail, webhook...). Single replica (no cluster gossip).

**Healthy**: Up, Config OK, *Notifications failed* = 0, Prometheus *send errors* = 0, and only `Watchdog`
in the firing table (Watchdog always fires on purpose: it proves the alerting path works end to end).

**Important in this lab**: `alertmanager_receivers` shows how many receivers exist. With only the default `null`
receiver, alerts are routed nowhere: notification panels stay at 0 and nobody is paged. Configure a real receiver
in the kube-prometheus-stack values (`alertmanager.config`) to get notified.

**When red**
- *Config FAILED* → the rendered config is invalid; Alertmanager keeps the previous one
  (`kubectl --context k8s01 -n monitoring logs alertmanager-kps-0 -c alertmanager`).
- *Notifications failed* → the receiver endpoint rejects/does not answer (credentials, URL, network).
- *Invalid alerts* → a client sends malformed alerts.

Formulas: [alertmanager-mixin](https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/tree/main/doc/alertmanager-mixin) (thresholds = AlertmanagerFailedToSendAlerts > 1%).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Scrape health of the Alertmanager container (`up`).

panels.title: Config
panels.description: `alertmanager_config_last_reload_successful`. Mixin alert AlertmanagerFailedReload (critical) fires when 0 for 10m.

panels.title: Receivers
panels.description: Receivers in the loaded config (`alertmanager_receivers`). 1 usually means only the default `null` receiver: alerts are not delivered anywhere.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Alerts currently active in Alertmanager (`alertmanager_alerts{state="active"}`, mixin 'Alerts' panel). Includes Watchdog.

panels.title: Suppressed
panels.description: Alerts muted by a silence or an inhibition rule (`alertmanager_alerts{state="suppressed"}`).

panels.title: Active silences
panels.description: Silences in effect (`alertmanager_silences{state="active"}`). Forgotten silences hide real problems: review them in the UI.

panels.title: Notifications failed (1h)
panels.description: Failed notification attempts in the last hour (`alertmanager_notifications_failed_total`). Mixin alert AlertmanagerFailedToSendAlerts fires above 1% of attempts per integration.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the Alertmanager process started. Alertmanager restarts lose in-flight notification state only if the volume is lost (it persists silences/nflog on a PVC).

panels.title: Silence / nflog errors (1h)
panels.description: Errors maintaining or querying silences and the notification log (`alertmanager_silences_query_errors_total`, `alertmanager_nflog_query_errors_total`, maintenance errors). Non-zero = state on disk is broken.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(alertmanager_silences_query_errors_total{job="kps-alertmanager", namespace="monitoring"}[1h])) + sum(increase(alertmanager_nflog_query_errors_total{job="kps-alertmanager", namespace="monitoring"}[1h])) + sum(increase(alertmanager_silences_maintenance_errors_total{job="kps-alertmanager", namespace="monitoring"}[1h])) + sum(increase(alertmanager_nflog_maintenance_errors_total{job="kps-alertmanager", namespace="monitoring"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Firing alerts (Prometheus ALERTS)
panels.description: Every alert currently firing in Prometheus (`ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}`), one line per alert name / severity / namespace. Watchdog is expected.

panels.title: Alerts by state
panels.description: Alerts held by Alertmanager by state (mixin 'Alerts' panel, `alertmanager_alerts`). unprocessed > 0 for long means the dispatcher is stuck.

panels.title: Alerts received / invalid
panels.description: Alerts posted by Prometheus per second and how many were rejected as invalid (mixin 'Alert receive rate': `alertmanager_alerts_received_total`, `alertmanager_alerts_invalid_total`).

panels.title: Notifications sent by integration
panels.description: Notification attempts per integration (mixin 'Notifications' panel: `alertmanager_notifications_total`). Only integrations used by a receiver ever move; all flat at 0 means no receiver is configured or nothing fired. Suppressed notifications (`alertmanager_notifications_suppressed_total`) were muted by silences/inhibitions.

panels.title: Notification failure ratio by integration
panels.description: Failed / total notifications per integration, the expression of mixin alert AlertmanagerFailedToSendAlerts (> 1% for 5m). Reason label explains: clientError (bad config/credentials), serverError, other.

targets.expr: sum by (integration, reason) (rate(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total{job="kps-alertmanager", namespace="monitoring"}[$__rate_interval])) / ignoring (reason) group_left sum by (integration) (rate(alertmanager_notifications_total{job="kps-alertmanager", namespace="monitoring"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Notification latency
panels.description: Time to deliver a notification, by integration (mixin 'Notification Duration' panel: p99 / median of `alertmanager_notification_latency_seconds`). Slow receivers delay pages.

panels.title: Aggregation groups
panels.description: Alert groups the dispatcher is tracking (`alertmanager_dispatcher_aggregation_groups`) and processing time. Each group is one notification thread (group_by labels).

panels.title: Notification requests failed (low level)
panels.description: HTTP/API requests to receivers that failed (`alertmanager_notification_requests_failed_total` / `_requests_total`, includes retries).

panels.title: Silences by state
panels.description: Silences by state (`alertmanager_silences`): active, pending (start in the future), expired (kept for retention).

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU used by the container (cAdvisor `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total`, rate) against its request (kube-state-metrics). No CPU limit is set in this lab (requests only), so the container can burst; sustained use far above the request means the request should be raised so the scheduler accounts for it. Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set (what the kernel OOM-killer looks at) against the memory request and limit. The working set reaching the limit means an OOMKill (watch the restart annotation). Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard (container_memory_working_set_bytes).

panels.title: Config-reloader sidecar
panels.description: `reloader_last_reload_successful` / failed reloads of the Alertmanager config-reloader (rule ConfigReloaderSidecarErrors).
